title: Whole Exome Sequencing in Finding Causative Variants in Germline DNA Samples From Patients With Congestive Heart Failure Receiving Therapy for Breast Cancer
brief_summary: This research trial studies whole exome sequencing in finding causative variants in germline deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) samples from patients with congestive heart failure receiving therapy for breast cancer. Studying samples of germline DNA in the laboratory from patients with congestive heart failure receiving therapy for breast cancer may help doctors learn more about changes that occur in DNA and identify biomarkers related to congestive heart failure.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* European American patients with DNA available
* European American patients who developed CHF and patients who did not develop CHF following a full course of treatment with an anthracycline and bevacizumab
* African American cases (based on a drop in left ventricular ejection fraction \[LVEF\] \< 50 or a drop from baseline \> 20 points) and African American controls
study_population: Patients with breast cancer enrolled on E5103 with or without congestive heart failure.
